Vietnam Trip Itinerary

Arrival — Hanoi, 11:50am, Oct 30
Departure — Hanoi, 1:30pm, Nov 13
Day 1 · Friday, October 30

Hanoi

Transfer Land Hanoi 11:50am → taxi to Silk Path Boutique (booked via Booking.com, standard car, ~€9), arrive ~1:30–2:30pm (allow 1.5–2.5hrs for immigration, baggage claim, and the ~45-60min drive)
Activities
  • Check in
  • Old Quarter
  • The Note Coffee
  • Train Street
  • Beer Street
Night Hanoi — Silk Path Boutique Hanoi 4★ (included in cruise package — confirmed by Ambassador Cruise)
Day 2 · Saturday, October 31

Hanoi → Ha Long Bay

Transfer 8:00am pickup from hotel → Ha Long port, ~10:30am (~2.5hrs)
Activities
  • Board Ambassador Cruise
  • Onboard excursions (Luon Cave, Sung Sot Cave)
  • Sundeck dinner with live band
Booking Ambassador Cruise — Hanoi & Ha Long Overnight Escape — booked at €284/person twin share. Note: 8am pickup is the morning right after landing, so there's no buffer for jet lag or a rough flight.
Night Aboard the Ambassador Cruise ship, Ha Long Bay
Day 3 · Sunday, November 1

Ha Long Bay → Hanoi

Transfer Disembark Ha Long port ~10:15am → Hanoi, ~5:00pm (~2.5hrs, incl. cave stop)
Activities
  • Sunrise tai chi
  • Titov Island swim
  • Breakfast on board
  • Dragon Pearl Cave show + “Tastes of the World” lunch
Night Hanoi — Ben's Apartment, city view room, 2 nights (Nov 1–3), ~€37 total. Booked. Check in Nov 1 (expect ~5–6pm after the cruise shuttle), check out early Nov 3 for the Sa Pa bus. Recommended by a friend, 8.9 on Booking, 10–15 min walk to the Old Quarter. The entrance is in a small alley and several places have similar "Ben's" names, so give drivers the exact address. Ambassador has been sent this address for the Day 3 drop-off. Tell Ben's you're leaving early on Nov 3.
Day 4 · Monday, November 2

Hanoi

Activities
  • 10am Massage: 90 min Swedish at MF Spa Hanoi
  • Rock King Coffee
  • Sky Lotte Observation Deck
  • X Space Immersive (optional)
Booking MF Spa Hanoi, 11 Bao Khanh Alley, Hoan Kiem (by Hoan Kiem Lake). 90 min Swedish massage at 10:00am, ~650,000–750,000 VND (≈ €21–25) pp. Booked.
Night Hanoi — Ben's Apartment (2nd night)
Day 5 · Tuesday, November 3

Hanoi → Sa Pa

Transfer HK Buslines 22-cabin sleeping bus, 07:00 from the HK office, 70 Nguyễn Hữu Huân (Old Quarter) → HK office, 732–734 Điện Biên Phủ, Sa Pa. Arrive ~1:00pm. 2 × lower single cabin, US$42.78, booked via Klook. Leave Ben's ~6:15 by Grab (~10 min) to be at the office by ~6:30.
Activities
  • Cat Cat Village (afternoon)
Night Sa Pa — Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa, Panorama View Bungalow (king bed, breakfast included), 4 nights (Nov 3–7), €449.85 total, booked via Klook (paid). No free cancellation after Oct 20. On the hillside above the Mường Hoa valley, under 2 km from the centre: 5–10 min by Xanh SM or Grab (~€2–4). The special request asked for luggage storage on Nov 7 and a taxi to the bus around 21:30.
Day 6 · Wednesday, November 4

Sa Pa

Activities
  • Paragliding over the Mường Hoa valley (weather-dependent). If it's grounded, swap with Nov 5, 6 or 7. Flights take off from Hàm Rồng mountain or above the valley; ~2.1–2.4M VND (~€70–80) pp when booked directly, often with hotel pickup
Night Sa Pa — Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa
Day 7 · Thursday, November 5

Sa Pa

Activities
  • Rong May Glass Bridge (day trip, ~17 km / 30–45 min each way over the O Quy Ho Pass)
Night Sa Pa — Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa
Day 8 · Friday, November 6

Sa Pa

Activities
  • Fansipan cable car + summit (runs in fog too, but go on the clearest day for the views)
Night Sa Pa — Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa
Day 9 · Saturday, November 7

Sa Pa → Hanoi

Transfer HK Buslines 22-cabin sleeping bus, 22:00 from the HK office, 732–734 Điện Biên Phủ, Sa Pa → Noi Bai Airport. Arrive ~4–5am on Nov 8. 2 × lower single cabin, US$43.78, booked via Klook. Ask HK (WhatsApp) to drop you at Terminal 1 (domestic). Your Sa Pa hotel needs to keep your bags after check-out until the evening.
Activities
  • Weather buffer day (last backup for paragliding); otherwise free time
Night Overnight on the bus
Day 10 · Sunday, November 8

Hanoi → Phu Quoc

Transfer Night bus arrives at Noi Bai ~4–5am → VietJet VJ449, 10:10 → 12:15, Hanoi → Phu Quoc. The bungalow's driver waits in arrivals with a "Valley Sen Bungalow" sign (free pickup). Booked via Booking.com (ref. 40-1091617222), Deluxe fare: 20kg checked bag + 7kg carry-on each, seats 27E/27F. Return ticket with Nov 12, €240.64 for 2 incl. travel protection.
Activities
  • Sao Beach
Night Phu Quoc — Phu Quoc Valley Sen Bungalow, 4 nights (Nov 8–12), €186.35 total, booked via Booking.com. Pay at the property in VND (5,400,000), free cancellation. Cửa Lấp, Dương Tơ, near Long Beach, ~10–15 min from the airport. 9.5 from 815 reviews. Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. Ask them to hold your bags on arrival (~1–1:30pm) and keep your luggage on Nov 12 until your 18:40 flight.
Day 11 · Monday, November 9

Phu Quoc

Activities
  • Duong Dong Market
  • Rory's Beach Bar
Night Phu Quoc — Phu Quoc Valley Sen Bungalow
Day 12 · Tuesday, November 10

Phu Quoc

Activities
  • Thom Island via cable car
Night Phu Quoc — Phu Quoc Valley Sen Bungalow
Day 13 · Wednesday, November 11

Phu Quoc

Activities
  • Massage
  • Ocsen Beach Bar & Club
Night Phu Quoc — Phu Quoc Valley Sen Bungalow
Day 14 · Thursday, November 12

Phu Quoc → Hanoi

Transfer VietJet VJ446, 18:40 → 20:45, Phu Quoc → Hanoi. Booked (same Booking.com return as Nov 8, ref. 40-1091617222). Deluxe, 20kg checked bag each, seats 27E/27F.
Activities
  • Grand World
Night Hanoi (buffer night before departure). Shortlisted: Westlake House by Jen, lake view room, Tây Hồ, 9.4 from 60 reviews. It's on the airport side of the city (~25–35 min to Noi Bai), with a quiet lakeside morning before the flight. Not booked yet. Book once the PQC→HAN flight is fixed, and confirm late check-in for the evening arrival.
Day 15 · Friday, November 13

Hanoi → Depart

Transfer Hotel → Noi Bai Airport, ~11:00am · flight departs 1:30pm
Activities
  • Free morning

Day 1 · Friday, October 30
Taxi · Booking.com, standard car

Noi Bai Airport → Silk Path Boutique Hanoi

Booked
DepartLand 11:50
Arrive~13:30–14:30
Duration45–60 min drive
Cost~€9 per car
Booked via Booking.com. The driver meets you in arrivals with a name sign. Hotel check-in is from 2pm.
Day 2 · Saturday, October 31
Shuttle · Ambassador Cruise

Silk Path Boutique → Halong International Cruise Port

Booked
Depart08:00 hotel pickup
Arrive~11:00 lounge check-in
Duration~2.5–3 hrs
CostIncluded in cruise
Boarding at 12:20. This is the morning after you land, so there is no buffer if the arrival flight is late.
Day 3 · Sunday, November 1
Shuttle · Ambassador Cruise

Ha Long Bay → Dragon Pearl Cave → Ben's Apartment, Hanoi

Booked
Depart10:15 off the ship · 14:30 from the cave
Arrive~17:00–18:00
Duration~2.5 hrs + cave stop
CostIncluded in cruise
Ben's address has been sent to Ambassador for the drop-off. Tell Ben's you'll arrive around 6pm.
Day 5 · Tuesday, November 3
Cabin bus · HK Buslines (Klook)

HK office, Old Quarter → Sa Pa

Booked
Depart07:00 · be there ~6:30
Arrive~13:00
Duration~6 hrs incl. 2 stops
CostUS$42.78 for 2 lower cabins
Booked on Klook. Departs from the HK office at 70 Nguyễn Hữu Huân. Take a Grab from Ben's around 6:15 (~10 min, ~€1–2). Drop-off at the HK office in Sa Pa, 732–734 Điện Biên Phủ, then a 5–10 min Xanh SM or Grab to Sapa Jade Hill Resort. No toilet on board, 2 stops. Ask HK on WhatsApp for adjacent cabins.
Day 7 · Thursday, November 5 · day trip
Easy Rider, Grab or tour

Sa Pa → Rong May Glass Bridge → Sa Pa

Arrange on the day
DepartMorning
ArriveBack in the afternoon
Duration~30–45 min each way (~17 km)
Cost~€5–25, depending on option
A round trip over the steep O Quy Ho Pass, often foggy and wet in November. Options: Easy Rider (on the back of a local driver's motorbike, ~€5–10 pp) or Grab/private car with waiting (~€15–25 per car). Your Sa Pa hotel can arrange either.
Day 9 · Saturday, November 7
Night cabin bus · HK Buslines (Klook)

Sa Pa → Noi Bai Airport, Hanoi

Booked
Depart22:00 · HK office, Sa Pa
ArriveNoi Bai ~4–5am, Nov 8
Duration~6 hrs
CostUS$43.78 for 2 lower cabins
Booked on Klook. Picks up at the HK office, 732–734 Điện Biên Phủ. Drops you straight at the airport, so no Grab needed on Nov 8. Ask HK on WhatsApp for Terminal 1 (domestic) and adjacent cabins. Sapa Jade Hill keeps your bags after check-out (requested), and a 5–10 min taxi to the office around 21:30 (requested from the resort).
Day 10 · Sunday, November 8
Domestic flight · VietJet, Deluxe

Hanoi (HAN) → Phu Quoc (PQC)

Booked
Depart10:10 · VJ449
Arrive12:15
Duration~2 hrs 10 min
Cost€240.64 return for 2
Booked via Booking.com (ref. 40-1091617222; the agency is OY SRG Finland). VietJet VJ449, Deluxe: 20kg checked bag + 7kg carry-on each, seats 27E/27F. About 5 hours of buffer after the night bus. Domestic flights leave from Noi Bai Terminal 1.
Pickup · arranged by the bungalow

Phu Quoc Airport → Valley Sen Bungalow

Booked
DepartAfter landing
Arrive~13:00–13:30
Duration~10–15 min
CostFree
The bungalow arranges the pickup for free: the driver waits in arrivals with a "Valley Sen Bungalow" sign. If you can't find them, Grab or Xanh SM is the fallback (~€4–6).
Day 14 · Thursday, November 12
Grab or taxi

Valley Sen Bungalow → Grand World → Phu Quoc Airport

Arrange on the day
DepartAfternoon
ArriveAirport ~1.5 hrs before the flight
Duration~30–45 min, Grand World to airport
Cost~€10–15 total
You'll have checked out, so ask the hotel to keep your bags or bring them along. Grand World is best in the evening, which clashes with an evening flight, so consider a later flight or an afternoon visit.
Domestic flight · VietJet, Deluxe

Phu Quoc (PQC) → Hanoi (HAN)

Booked
Depart18:40 · VJ446
Arrive20:45
Duration~2 hrs 10 min
CostIncl. in the return ticket
Booked, same return ticket as Nov 8. VietJet VJ446, Deluxe, 20kg checked bag each, seats 27E/27F. You'll reach Westlake House around 21:30–22:00.
Grab or taxi

Noi Bai Airport → Westlake House, Tây Hồ

Arrange on the day
DepartAfter landing
ArriveLate evening
Duration~25–35 min
Cost~€7–10 per car
Late arrival, so confirm late check-in with the host. A pre-booked taxi is an option if you'd rather not use Grab late at night.
Day 15 · Friday, November 13
Grab or taxi

Westlake House → Noi Bai Airport

Arrange on the day
Depart~11:00–11:30
Arrive~12:00
Duration~25–35 min
Cost~€7–10 per car
Flight home at 13:30. International check-in usually closes about 60 min before departure.

Open Items to Confirm

  • Book Westlake House for Nov 12 (flight lands 20:45, so confirm late check-in around 21:30–22:00)
  • WhatsApp HK Buslines: adjacent cabins on both buses, and the Nov 7 drop-off at Noi Bai Terminal 1
  • Sapa Jade Hill: check they confirmed the special request (luggage storage on Nov 7, taxi to the bus ~21:30)
  • Book paragliding for Nov 4 (Nov 5–7 as backups), ideally with hotel pickup and free rescheduling for bad weather
  • Valley Sen Bungalow: airport pickup arranged (sign "Valley Sen Bungalow"). Pickup is free. Still confirm bags on arrival Nov 8 (~1pm), and luggage storage on Nov 12 until the 18:40 flight
  • Day 2's 8am cruise pickup leaves no buffer if the arrival flight is delayed or rough
